cd /workspace/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
rnd=random.Random(3)
svcs=['svc%02d'%i for i in range(24)]
# 10 contains atoms with long random patterns -> product should blow the cap fast
at=[{'op':'contains','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
req={'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':at}}],'queries':[]}
line=json.dumps(req).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=line*8, capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
print('cap-blow case: bytes=%d rc=%d wall=%.2fs' % (len(line), p.returncode, t1-t0))
print([json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x][:3])

# same but with endswith (different monitor widths)
at2=[{'op':'endswith','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
req2={'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':at2}}],'queries':[]}
line2=json.dumps(req2).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=line2*8, capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
o=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x][0]
print('endswith case: wall=%.2fs ->' % (t1-t0), o.get('error') or len(o['dfa']['accept']))

# match atoms with long patterns
at3=[{'op':'match','path':[rnd.choice(svcs) for _ in range(16)]} for _ in range(10)]
req3={'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':at3}}],'queries':[]}
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=json.dumps(req3).encode()*8, capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
o=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x][0]
print('match case: wall=%.2fs ->' % (t1-t0), o.get('error') or len(o['dfa']['accept']))
PYEOF
